text_block_list.text: Sounds of Earth's Classic Year was finally about to begin—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —Bellissima...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Don't you think it's a beautiful sunrise,
Trainer...!

"...Brought along by Sounds of Earth,
I was here to take in the early morning air."
Originally, we were just going to talk about "reviewing last year," but there was a bit of a reason why we ended up going outside like this—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: "—Since we're here, why don't the two of us share a chat on this quiet winter morning?"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: "I'm sure our words will resonate with each other, and it'll turn out to be a very meaningful time."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, since I'm inviting you,
I've prepared a little 'treat' for you as well—"

"—And so, after hearing Sounds of Earth's request,
here I am, bright and early in the morning."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ...I rather like early winter mornings like this.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
The sensation of the slumbering earth slowly
awakening to the morning sun washes over me...
It feels irresistibly comforting.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
My thoughts feel crystal clear, and look—
you can hear the sounds so crisply, too, right?

...Indeed, the chilly air and the silence unique to morning
really make the sounds around me stand out.
That sensation soon clearly carves out the contours of my existence, bringing the sound of my breathing under the freezing sky into sharp relief along with my white breath—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Oops...! Looks like
your body got a little chilled.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Well then, shall we move on to the "fun part" soon?
Saying that, Sounds of Earth took out two thermoses, mixed their contents in a cup, and handed it to me.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Here.
I'm sure this'll warm you up.

As prompted, I take a sip.
A gentle sweetness and deep bitterness spread at once,
warming up my chilled body...!
choice_data_list: Oh...! Is this a soy latte?
Wow...! Is this a soy milk latte?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: That's right!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I love it. Both latte di soia,
and sipping it beneath a cold winter sky like this.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
And today, you are here with me.
...That makes the experience all the more flavorful.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Prego! I should be the one thanking you.
Grazie for keeping me company—"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ...Now, let us turn our discussion to the main topic.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: First, Direttore, how did you view last year's Twinkle Series?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: First, Direttrice, how did you view last year's Twinkle Series?
"As expected, I couldn't help but pay attention to the exploits of those particular Umamusume—Orfevre and Gentildonna."

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: —Taking the inside path is Gentildonna!! It's Gentildonna!!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —Hmph!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Gentildonna takes the lead!!
Gentildonna!!
Gentildonnaaaa!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
This is the pride of the strongest queen!!
Gentildonna takes it!!
(WOOOOOOOOOOH!!!!!)
—Gentildonna achieved an unprecedented back-to-back victory in the Japan Cup, carving her name into history once again.
Meanwhile—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Orfevre makes her move! 400 meters remaining!!
How will Orfevre cap off her final race of the year?!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Daaaaaaaahhh!!!!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Burn it into your memory!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Taking the lead at the 4th corner!!!
The gap with the rest of the pack widens!!!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Ngh...! Dammit...!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—This is it!! This is ittt!!!
THIS IS ORFEVREEEEE!!!!
(WOOOOOOOOOOH!!!!!)

...After suffering a narrow defeat in 2nd place
at her second Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe,
Orfevre announced her retirement from racing at the Arima Kinen.

And in that Arima Kinen, he claimed a landslide
victory by eight lengths over second place, demonstrating
the sheer strength fitting of the "Golden Tyrant"—

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
—After seeing amazing performances like that from Orfe and Gentil,
you kind of, well,
feel a difference when looking at other generations.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text: It was just so incredible it blew my mind, or rather... I wonder if I'll ever get to see a race like that again...?

—Even now, many still mourned Orfevre's absence,
and voices extolling the brilliance of the older generation abounded.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —It's a miracle.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: It was truly remarkable that two such vivid presences stood on the stage of the same era, harmonizing in an impetuoso melody.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Many who love racing must have felt it.
'Will an era like this ever happen again?!'

Indeed, the feats of Orfevre and her peers are glories that should be passed down for generations.
However, that doesn't mean—
Nothing is set in stone saying the path Sounds of Earth will run will pale in comparison to Orfevre's legacy...!
choice_data_list: Let's thrill the era once again with your running...!
Let's set the era abuzz again with your running...!

text_block_list.text: Sounds of Earth steadily grew stronger during the Junior Class. Her target Classic races are becoming a realistic goal.
Surely, her running from here on out will forge a new era and bring wild excitement to everyone.

And for that sake, I want to elevate
Sounds of Earth's abilities to the absolute limit
with the time remaining until spring...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
—You're right. Let's believe in everything we've built up to today,
and continue taking decisive steps until spring...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
âLook, see?
The sunlight is just like a pure, pristine blessing.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Drawing warmth from this radiance,
let us begin the rest of our day, shall we?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
How would you wave your baton, Direttore?
I'd love to hear your thoughts.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
How would you wave your baton, Direttrice?
I'd love to hear your thoughts.

It seems Sounds of Earth is asking about the plans after this.
What came to my mind was—
choice_data_list: Let's start with a jam session.

text_block_list.text:
I blurted out that doing it in this early morning air
seemed like it would feel refreshing, but—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —Molto bene!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Radio calisthenics, that's great!
Do it with energy and you'll be brimming with vitality, no doubt about it!
choice_data_list: (The response is better than I expected...!)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right, since we're at it, why not play the second movement too?
I rather fancy its richly varied composition—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —Uno, due, tre, quattro!
Doing the radio calisthenics side by side was far more fun than imagined, creating a wonderful sense of unity—
A few days later—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Phew...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Sì! It certainly might be that time.
A cheerful sound might just
escape from my stomach...!
choice_data_list: That said, I wonder if any places are open at this hour?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fufuâ
Next, it is my turn to respond to your conducting.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Come along, Trainer.
Let me show you somewhere nice.

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you for waiting.
Here is your breakfast set.

The place Sounds of Earth guided me to was an old-fashioned, hidden-away cafe.
Classical music is playing softly in the background...

The sandwich and coffee from the morning set on the table
looked delicious, and the shop had a wonderful atmosphere—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
“...I found this place on an early morning walk.
I drop by now and then to enjoy some espresso and music.”

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
How is it?
Do you like it, Trainer?
choice_data_list: It's such a relaxing, lovely shop.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
—Benissimo.
That is the highest praise.

"And so, Sounds of Earth and I
spent a calm time together,
listening to the music for a while—"
A few days later—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Phew...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
—Benissimo!!
As expected of my direttore,
who holds such a passionate melody in his heart!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
—Benissimo!!
As expected of my direttrice,
who holds such a passionate melody in her heart!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"In anticipation of something like this,
I made sure to prepare one for you.
—Here, take it."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
—The world isn't fully awake yet.
Let's keep it a bit quieter and gentler.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Now then, let us offer our melody unto this morning—

"And so, after an early morning session
with Sounds of Earth,
our sense of unity deepened."
A few days later—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Phew...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: (...Fufu. That was a satisfying run, even if I say so myself. I can really feel my growth...!)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: (Is this the fruit of our daily work, Direttore? However, I cannot afford to be satisfied just yet—)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: (Is this the fruit of our daily work, Direttrice? However, I cannot afford to be satisfied just yet—)

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text:
—Hey there, Earth-kun!
You're doing voluntary training today too, huh?

text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text:
Good work.
Your running form looks to be in top shape.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Grazie! Spring is just around the corner, after all.
I must hone my sound with everything I have, running as my heart desires day after day.

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text:
Honing it with everything you've got, huh?
You're right about that...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"My, my—
That's not like you. You sound and look rather distressed."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
If you wouldn't mind, please tell me what troubles you.
As a fellow performer sharing this moment in time, I want to help.

text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text:
...Earth is involved in this too,
so I guess I should let her hear it.

text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text:
—I believe all of us did everything we could
during our Junior year.

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text:
Though our paces may differ, our generation
truly exists, and it is ready to bloom.

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text: ...However, how is the real racing world doing?

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text:
—The generation right above us.
Their overwhelming brilliance
continues to captivate people's hearts even now.

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text:
Far from weakening,
that momentum is only growing stronger by the second...!

text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text:
If we looked down in the dumps,
well... it was probably because
we were agonizing over that.

text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text: In short, it's about whether we can run without being overshadowed by the older generation, and if people will actually watch us—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text:
"...What are your thoughts on this, Earth?
You should know very well how formidable the older generation is."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ...My thoughts are—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Molto bene!!! Absolutely magnificent!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
They are, so to speak, rare virtuosos.
It's precisely because there are overwhelming stars
that the audience flocks to the theater...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"In other words, the Twinkle Series is drawing
an unprecedented amount of attention right now,
ranking among the highest in its entire history!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I'm fired up to celebrate that fantastico
and deliver a performance that carries on
such roaring enthusiasm!

text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text:
...Well, that's true.
I suppose you could say it's gotten the racing world
all hyped up...

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text:
Rather than empty seats in the stands,
it's better to have crowds overflowing in search of a star—
Yeah. That's a great way to look at it...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Yes, which is why we must keep honing it!
A melody uniquely our own!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
(The two of them seemed convinced back then,
but their footsteps still echoed with unease...)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
(...For the ultimate session,
the runner's peak motivation is indisputably essential――)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ...I'll need to think about this for a bit.

At this moment, a subtle nuance was added
to the sound of Sounds of Earth's footsteps—
though no one was able to notice it.
